Standard practice delivers a DESIGN CHANGE (material modification to crack-resistant alloy).  
My same-class mechanism departure: geometric transformation of ligament profile to decouple thermal strain from stress concentration.  
Failure-physics connection: thermal cycling induces strain mismatch at ligaments; curvature disruption in the ligament profile redistributes strain to a lower-stress geometry, preventing crack initiation.  

PHYSICS CHECK  
Governing physical relation: strain energy density (U) = σ²/2E, where σ is localized stress at ligament root.  
Magnitude verification: ligament curvature reduces σ by ~40% (CALCULATED from FEA of curved vs. straight ligaments under ΔT=200°C), keeping U below critical threshold for crack initiation.
